Well done Chris Griffin and Mark Aldred who made it to the 1991 UK Boys lists. Chris was equal 21st over 80m hurdles with his win at Kingsmeadow in the Woolworth's YA League on June 23rd, while Mark's 12.24 triple jump at Battersea on July 21st, again in the league, took him to 8th best in the country.
